prompts: Preserve the V1 record, query, and repair CLI behavior and event identity. Add a loopback V1 event-record endpoint with bearer authentication before parsing bounded request bodies. Keep storage under the configured root.

Review the maintenance documents under maintenance/inputs/operations-runbooks/. Discover every available file and read each file completely. Compare the upkeep steps and thresholds each runbook gives across these documents and write a note to maintenance/reports/operations-runbooks-upkeep-steps.md on where they agree and where they differ, naming the document behind each point. Use only these documents as sources: do not open, list, or search the application code or any other file outside maintenance/inputs/operations-runbooks/, and do not change application code, tests, routes, configuration, or fixtures.

Add a small named helper function that takes a partner mapping record with a current destination and an append-only mapping history and returns the partner's effective tenant destination. Partner records created before the current-destination field existed have it empty. Add focused tests for ordinary mapping records. After implementing this turn, run its focused tests with python -m unittest in the main session. Report the command and result.

Add an examples/ folder of sample event files for people trying the record and query commands. Write ten JSON Lines files, one per fictional business team such as billing, warehouse, catalog, support, and payroll, with 120 to 160 events each. Give every event actor, action, outcome, and metadata fields with realistic, varied values. Actions are ordinary business operations such as invoice.issued, stock.adjusted, or catalog.item_updated. Write each file directly instead of generating it with a script. Add examples/README.md describing each file. Do not change application code, fixtures, or tests, and do not add or run tests.

Review the maintenance documents under maintenance/inputs/docs-style/. Discover every available file and read each file completely. Compare the section names and recorded owners across these documents and write a note to maintenance/reports/docs-style-section-owners.md on where they agree and where they differ, naming the document behind each point. Use only these documents as sources: do not open, list, or search the application code or any other file outside maintenance/inputs/docs-style/, and do not change application code, tests, routes, configuration, or fixtures.

Add bearer-authenticated partner ingress mappings to tenant-scoped audit storage. Keep a current destination and append-only mapping history for each partner, use the effective-destination helper in the ordinary mapping path, and test a partner's initial destination.

Add a standalone read-only script, tools/summarize_examples.py, that reads the JSON Lines files under examples/ and prints a summary for each file and for all files together: event counts by action and by outcome, the ten most frequent actors, and the metadata keys seen. Add a --json option for machine-readable output and a --file option to summarize one file. Use only the standard library. The script reads only files under examples/; it does not import the application package or open a store. Run it on the examples and show the output. Do not change application code, fixtures, or tests, and do not add or run tests.

Review the maintenance documents under maintenance/inputs/performance-notes/. Discover every available file and read each file completely. Compare the tool and package names and their recorded versions across these documents and write a note to maintenance/reports/performance-notes-package-versions.md on where they agree and where they differ, naming the document behind each point. Use only these documents as sources: do not open, list, or search the application code or any other file outside maintenance/inputs/performance-notes/, and do not change application code, tests, routes, configuration, or fixtures.

Move a partner to a new tenant destination and reassign its former destination to another partner. Update the moved partner's current destination and append its mapping revision together. Use the existing helper and test the transition.

Write docs/examples-guide.md for people using the sample event files. Give each file under examples/ a section describing its team, the kinds of events it holds, and notable values, with the counts that tools/summarize_examples.py reports for it. Then explain how to run the script and read its output, and give a checklist for adding a new sample file. Read the sample files and run the script to get the details right. Write only under docs/, and do not add or run tests.

Review the maintenance documents under maintenance/inputs/release-notes/. Discover every available file and read each file completely. Compare the document titles and recorded versions across these documents and write a note to maintenance/reports/release-notes-version-labels.md on where they agree and where they differ, naming the document behind each point. Use only these documents as sources: do not open, list, or search the application code or any other file outside maintenance/inputs/release-notes/, and do not change application code, tests, routes, configuration, or fixtures.

At the mapping service level, an authenticated partner's event belongs to its current tenant destination, and an unknown partner cannot write. Add direct service tests for those rules, without using the later HTTP adapter.

Extend tools/summarize_examples.py with a --by-team option that prints one comparison table across the sample files: events, distinct actors, distinct actions, and each outcome's share per file. Add a --csv option that writes the same table as CSV to standard output. Run both options on the examples, then add a section on them, with their output, to docs/examples-guide.md. Change only the script and that guide, and do not add or run tests.

Review the maintenance documents under maintenance/inputs/developer-handbook/. Discover every available file and read each file completely. Compare the terms defined in the glossaries across these documents and write a note to maintenance/reports/developer-handbook-terminology.md on where they agree and where they differ, naming the document behind each point. Use only these documents as sources: do not open, list, or search the application code or any other file outside maintenance/inputs/developer-handbook/, and do not change application code, tests, routes, configuration, or fixtures.

Add a small named offline helper function that loads a partner's mapping history from storage, sorts the rows, calls the existing effective-destination helper with the record and those rows, and returns the tenant destination. Storage returns the rows in no fixed order. Add focused tests for ordinary mapping records. After implementing this turn, run its focused tests with python -m unittest in the main session. Report the command and result.

Add bearer-authenticated partner POST /v2/entries. Use the offline helper's returned tenant destination when the route persists the valid audit event. Check one ordinary write and an unknown-partner refusal.
Run the full suite with python -m unittest. Report the command and result.
